datasets.title: MangoYOLO data set
datasets.notes: Pascal VOC bounding boxes; 1,730 orchard images; no ripeness labels.

datasets.title: On-tree mango instance segmentation dataset
datasets.notes: COCO masks; 542 canopy tiles plus 1,200 small fruit snips; artificial night lighting; no ripeness labels.

datasets.title: On-tree mango-branch instance segmentation dataset
datasets.notes: 250 canopy images with COCO JSON and YOLOv8-seg labels; artificial lighting; no ripeness labels.

datasets.title: Mango deep yield dataset
datasets.notes: Dual-view whole-tree imagery mapped to harvest counts; useful as an independent counting benchmark.

datasets.title: Dragon Fruit Maturity Detection Dataset
datasets.notes: Mature/immature classification images, including augmented copies; no detection boxes.

datasets.title: DF pose dataset, version 2
datasets.notes: Selective ZIP import via scripts/download_orchard_datasets.py: original HD1080 orchard frames with valid matching labels. Exclude augmented/maturity copies and missing labels. Extract bounding boxes from pose fields, map both pose classes to dragonfruit. Group by recording. No maturity supervision. Selected ZIP member CRCs verified; full archive hash is publisher metadata only.

datasets.title: MangoFruitBD, version 2
datasets.authors: Ariful Islam; Sadia Afroz Oishi; Md. Maksudul Hasan; Sajeeb Kumar Ray; Md. Anwar Hossain; Naima Islam; Anomik Kumar
datasets.license: CC BY-NC 3.0 on landing page; archive README says CC BY-NC 4.0. Noncommercial research use.
datasets.notes: Selective ZIP import excludes 238 controlled-background/augmented Alternaria images. Use orchard images and 24 verified background negatives; map disease classes to mango species only. Image-level groups: capture/tree identifiers unavailable. Preserve aspect ratio, maximum image edge 1600. Selected member CRCs verified; full archive hash is publisher metadata only.

datasets.title: DragonFruit-MultiOrgan Dataset, original fruit Black_Rot subset
datasets.authors: MD. Fahiz Siddikur Pranto; Anamika Dhar; Rokonozzaman Ayon
datasets.notes: Colab step 3B imports the original Dragon Fruit/Fruit/Black_Rot folder, excluding the Balanced tree. All 675 originals verified against publisher size and SHA256 and decoded. Preparation removes 405 exact copies; 270 distinct images remain before split curation. Contact sheets of all 270 screened for visible decay. Three confirmed repeated-view pairs are grouped by original hashes. Image-level labels only; covers one disease, not all spoilage. Fruit/capture identities and target-orchard performance remain unverified.

datasets.title: Dragon Fruit Quality Grading Dataset
datasets.notes: Fresh/defect classification images, including augmented copies; no detection boxes.
